start: Linked member, no open shop orders; Shop, Leave

user_sees: 'Leave <gym>?' and 'Your workouts stay on this phone. You can join again with the code.' with 'Leave gym' / 'Stay'
must_not: Leave done without the question, or workouts deleted from the phone

user_sees: The app goes back to the join card; for a branded gym the colours go back to MettleUp's
must_not: The gym's hours, offer, board or messages still on the phone

user_sees: The member's key stops working; both numbers are cleared on the server
must_not: The member still counted in the gym's messages

start: Member opens an invite link of another gym ('Switch to <gym>') while open orders exist at the old gym

user_sees: 'Switch to <gym>?' naming the open orders
must_not: The old gym's orders cancelled before the new gym answers

user_sees: The new gym is checked first, then the old orders are cancelled, then the member joins the new gym
must_not: The member left with no gym because the new gym could not be reached

user_sees: 'You have 1 open order (₹450). Leaving cancels it.' (or for a ready order: '1 order is ready at the desk. Collect it or ask the desk to cancel it before you leave.')
must_not: An open order left at the desk after the member leaves

user_sees: Every 'ordered' order is cancelled first, then the leave
must_not: Leaving before the cancel succeeds

start: The cancel of an open order fails, or member taps Stay

steps.action: Confirm leave while the cancel fails
user_sees: "Your order isn't cancelled yet" with 'Try again' / 'Not now'
must_not: The member out of the gym with the order still open

user_sees: Still in the gym; nothing changed
must_not: A half leave: key forgotten but orders still open

user_sees: The join card says 'You left <gym> on this phone. The gym couldn't be reached, so it will be told the next time the app is online.'
must_not: The leave forgotten when the app is closed

user_sees: The kept key is sent again and removed once the gym confirms
must_not: The member's number left on the server for good

steps.action: Join the same gym again with the code
user_sees: A fresh link; the old pending key is still sent
must_not: The new link cancelled by the old pending leave

steps.action: Gym staff look at the member
user_sees: The app link is gone; the member's leaderboard numbers, trainer summary, machine use, shared workouts and questions are deleted
must_not: Any of those still visible to the gym or other members

user_sees: Only the member key is kept until the gym confirms; no name, number or gym
must_not: The old gym's data left on the phone
